findings.evidence: Line 50 `namespace SubMulAction` / line 248 `end SubMulAction`; line 250 `namespace TauCeti` with `variable ... (S : SubMulAction ...) [Finite S]` at lines 256–257 and `open _root_.SubMulAction` at line 252 to reach the first half.
findings.fix: Put the whole sequence API in one namespace — `SubMulAction`, consistent with the dot-notation half already there (lines 50–248) and with the in-repo precedent `SubMulAction.rootsOfUnityQuotientHomeomorph`.
findings.issue: The same API, all with `S : SubMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L))` as first explicit argument, is split across two namespaces: `SubMulAction.{smul_mem_sUnits, sUnitAction, sUnitRep, sUnitValuation, sUnitInclusion, range_sUnitInclusion_eq_ker_sUnitValuation, finiteIndex_range_sUnitValuation}` but `TauCeti.{sUnitInclusion_comp_sUnitValuation, sUnitShortComplex, sUnitShortComplex_X₁/X₂/X₃/f/g, sUnitShortComplex_shortExact, finite_cokernel_sUnitValuation_image_ι}`. So `S.sUnitValuation` elaborates while `S.sUnitShortComplex` does not, and `TauCeti.sUnitInclusion_comp_sUnitValuation` names two declarations that live elsewhere.

findings.evidence: Lines 273–279 define the fields by structure literal; line 297 `HEq (sUnitShortComplex S).f (sUnitInclusion S) := (HEq.rfl)`; `TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Exact/Conflation.lean:226` shows the repo's `_heq`-suffixed spelling.
findings.fix: State both as `Eq` (`(sUnitShortComplex S).f = sUnitInclusion S`, closed by `rfl`), or, if `Eq` is genuinely wanted off, rename to `sUnitShortComplex_f_heq`/`_g_heq` and drop `@[simp]`, as in `TauCeti.ConflationClass.opEquivalence_functor_map_hom_heq`.
findings.issue: `sUnitShortComplex_f` and `sUnitShortComplex_g` (line 301) are named in the style of structure-field equations (cf. the adjacent `sUnitShortComplex_X₁/X₂/X₃`, which are `Eq`), but are stated as `HEq`. `HEq` is strictly weaker here — it is not usable by `rw`, and the `@[simp]` attribute on both cannot fire — while the types are definitionally equal, since `(sUnitShortComplex S).X₁`/`.X₂` delta-reduce to `Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (𝓞 L)ˣ` and `sUnitRep S`.

findings.evidence: Lines 43–47 vs. `MonoidAlgebra.basis_repr` (line 66), `MonoidAlgebra.coeff_basis_toDualEquiv_symm_apply` (line 74), `MonoidAlgebra.sumCoords_basis_surjective` (line 89), all inside `namespace TauCeti` (line 40); docstring lines 28–35 list them as `TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.*`.
findings.fix: Rename so both sides appear (e.g. `monoidAlgebraEquivFunMultiplicative`, cf. `MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv`, `Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite`) and file it in the same namespace as the file's other declarations.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.funMultiplicativeIntLinearEquiv : Additive (X → Multiplicative ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ] MonoidAlgebra ℤ X` names only the source side (borrowed from `MulEquiv.funMultiplicative`) plus the scalar ring the type already fixes; nothing in the name says it lands in `MonoidAlgebra ℤ X`. It is also the only declaration in this file outside the `TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra` namespace used by every neighbour and by the module docstring's `Main statements` list.

findings.evidence: Conclusion at line 59 is `g • u ∈ (S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L))).unit L`; `Set.unit` is defined at `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/SInteger.lean:108`. Naming conventions: "the definition should have its namespace removed ... to ensure that `_`-separated strings in a lemma name correspond to a definition name or connective."
findings.fix: Rename to `smul_mem_unit`, matching the declaration in the conclusion.
findings.issue: `smul_mem_sUnits` has a name segment `sUnits` that corresponds to no declaration — the conclusion is membership in `Set.unit`, Mathlib's S-unit subgroup — and the plural is inconsistent with every sibling name in the file (`sUnitRep`, `sUnitValuation`, `sUnitInclusion`).

summary: One S-indexed API is split arbitrarily between the `SubMulAction` and `TauCeti` namespaces, two simp lemmas are named as field equations but stated as `HEq`, and the new monoid-algebra equivalence has a name that omits its target and a namespace inconsistent with its file.
